title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
one_line_judgement: 值得继续观察：据摘要（arXiv 2610.02206）：KaliBench 是 cybersecurity tool use benchmark，运行在…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02206）：KaliBench 是 cybersecurity tool use benchmark，运行在 Kali Linux，明确点出'real-world cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag-value bindings' 等痛点；并配 runtime-free verifiable rewards（无运行代价的可验证奖励），把 agents 与终点栈拉到 'strict-syntax CLI invocation' 评测层级。是 llm-evaluation × ai-agent × security-governance 的'strict-syntax tool-use benchmark'趋势资产——'runtime-free verifiable reward + strict CLI syntax'范式可迁移到任何 'tool-use agent benchmark' 子方向（DevOps / DB admin / cloud CLI 等）；与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × security-governance 主线高度对齐。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 CLI 覆盖范围、reward 形式化、跨 LLM baseline、'runtime-free' 实现细节。今日动作：趋势卡片维护。
